[Section] Inexpensive Domain Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models (Appendix) ::: Experiment 2: Covid-19 QA ::: Data
[source_id=72] We downloaded the Deepset-AI Covid-QA dataset from:
[source_id=73] https://github.com/deepset-ai/COVID-QA/blob/master/data/question-answering/200423_covidQA.json [24 April 2020]
[source_id=74] At the time of writing, the dataset contains 1380 questions and gold answer spans. Every question is associated with one of 98 research papers (contexts). We treat the entire dataset as a test set.
[source_id=75] Note that there are some important differences between the dataset and SQuAD, which make the task challenging:
[source_id=76] The contexts are full documents rather than single paragraphs. Thus, the correct answer may appear several times, often with slightly different wordings. Only a single one of the occurrences is annotated as correct, e.g.:
[source_id=77] What was the prevalence of Coronavirus OC43 in community samples in Ilorin, Nigeria?
[source_id=78] 13.3% (95% CI 6.9-23.6%) # from main text
[source_id=79] (13.3%, 10/75). # from abstract
[source_id=80] SQuAD gold answers are defined as the “shortest span in the paragraph that answered the question” BIBREF19, but many Covid-QA gold answers are longer and contain non-essential context, e.g.:
[source_id=81] When was the Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus isolated first?
[source_id=82] (MERS-CoV) was first isolated in 2012, in a 60-year-old man who died in Jeddah, KSA due to severe acute pneumonia and multiple organ failure
[source_id=83] 2012,

The contexts are full documents rather than single paragraphs. Thus, the correct answer may appear several times, often with slightly different wordings. Only a single one of the occurrences is annotated as correct, e.g.:
What was the prevalence of Coronavirus OC43 in community samples in Ilorin, Nigeria?
SQuAD gold answers are defined as the “shortest span in the paragraph that answered the question” BIBREF19, but many Covid-QA gold answers are longer and contain non-essential context, e.g.:
When was the Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus isolated first?
(MERS-CoV) was first isolated in 2012, in a 60-year-old man who died in Jeddah, KSA due to severe acute pneumonia and multiple organ failure
